-- Check product and tag exist
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product.tb_p_product p
INNER JOIN product.tb_p_product_version pv ON p.product_id = pv.product_id
INNER JOIN product.tb_p_product_template pt ON pv.template_id = pt.product_template_id
INNER JOIN product.tb_p_product_template_set pts ON pt.product_template_id = pts.product_template_id
INNER JOIN product.tb_p_product_template_version ptv ON pts.product_template_version_id = ptv.product_template_version_id
INNER JOIN product.tb_p_product_template_tag_value pttv ON ptv.product_template_tag_value_id = pttv.product_template_tag_value_id
INNER JOIN product.tb_p_product_template_tag_value_set pttvs ON pttv.product_template_tag_value_id = pttvs.product_template_tag_value_id
WHERE p.product_id = @product_id
AND pttvs.tag_id = @tag_id)
BEGIN
	RETURN;
END

DECLARE @modified_on datetime
set @modified_on = GETUTCDATE();

-- Get current product template id
DECLARE @current_product_version_id int
DECLARE @current_product_template_id int
SELECT @current_product_version_id = pv.product_version_id, @current_product_template_id = pv.template_id
FROM product.tb_p_product p
INNER JOIN product.tb_p_product_version pv ON p.product_id = pv.product_id AND pv.is_current_version = 1
WHERE p.product_id = @product_id

--SELECT @current_product_template_id

-- Get list of current product template set id
DECLARE @current_product_template_set_id_list TABLE
(product_template_set_id int)
INSERT INTO @current_product_template_set_id_list
SELECT pts.product_template_set_id
FROM product.tb_p_product_template_set pts
WHERE pts.product_template_id = @current_product_template_id
ORDER BY pts.product_template_set_id

-- Insert product template
DECLARE @new_product_template_id int
INSERT product.tb_p_product_template DEFAULT VALUES;
SELECT @new_product_template_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

DECLARE @current_product_template_set_id int
DECLARE @new_product_template_tag_value_id_list TABLE
(product_template_tag_value_id int not null)

DECLARE C CURSOR FOR
SELECT product_template_set_id FROM @current_product_template_set_id_list

OPEN C;
FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @current_product_template_set_id
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	-- Insert product template tag value
	DECLARE @product_template_tag_value_id int
	INSERT INTO product.tb_p_product_template_tag_value DEFAULT VALUES;
	SELECT @product_template_tag_value_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
	
	INSERT INTO @new_product_template_tag_value_id_list VALUES (@product_template_tag_value_id)
	
	-- Copy product template tag value set
	INSERT INTO product.tb_p_product_template_tag_value_set
	(product_template_tag_value_id, tag_id, value, text_value)
	SELECT @product_template_tag_value_id, pttvs.tag_id, pttvs.value, pttvs.text_value
	FROM product.tb_p_product_template_set pts
	INNER JOIN product.tb_p_product_template_version ptv ON pts.product_template_version_id = ptv.product_template_version_id
	INNER JOIN product.tb_p_product_template_tag_value pttv ON ptv.product_template_tag_value_id = pttv.product_template_tag_value_id
	INNER JOIN product.tb_p_product_template_tag_value_set pttvs ON pttv.product_template_tag_value_id = pttvs.product_template_tag_value_id
	WHERE pts.product_template_set_id = @current_product_template_set_id
	
	-- Copy product template version
	DECLARE @product_template_version_id int
	INSERT INTO product.tb_p_product_template_version
	(template_version_id, product_template_tag_value_id)
	SELECT ptv.template_version_id, @product_template_tag_value_id
	FROM product.tb_p_product_template_set pts
	INNER JOIN product.tb_p_product_template_version ptv ON pts.product_template_version_id = ptv.product_template_version_id
	WHERE pts.product_template_set_id = @current_product_template_set_id
	SELECT @product_template_version_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
	
	-- Copy product_template_set
	INSERT INTO product.tb_p_product_template_set
	(product_template_id, template_type, product_template_version_id, template_sub_type)
	SELECT @new_product_template_id, pts.template_type, @product_template_version_id, pts.template_sub_type
	FROM product.tb_p_product_template_set pts
	WHERE pts.product_template_set_id = @current_product_template_set_id
	
	FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @current_product_template_set_id
END

CLOSE C
DEALLOCATE C

SET @tx2_value_base = (SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, COUNT(1)) FROM Product WHERE ProductType = 2 AND ProductSubType = 2 AND IsMasterProduct = 0) --Value-based

INSERT INTO AcceptanceLoopMigrationDefault (Id, MerchantCode, MerchantShop)
SELECT M.Id, M.IdentityCode,
STUFF((
	SELECT ';' + M.IdentityCode + ISNULL('_' + S.IdentityCode, '')
	FROM Shop S
	WHERE S.MerchantId = M.Id
	ORDER BY M.IdentityCode, S.IdentityCode
	FOR XML PATH('')
), 1, 1, '') MerchantShop
FROM Merchant M

UPDATE AcceptanceLoopMigrationDefault SET MerchantShop = MerchantCode WHERE MerchantShop IS NULL

INSERT INTO AcceptanceLoopMigration (AcceptanceLoopId, Merchant, MerchantShop, MerchantCount, ShopCount)
SELECT AL.Id,
STUFF((
	SELECT ';' + M.IdentityCode
	FROM AcceptanceLoopMerchant ALM
	INNER JOIN Merchant M ON ALM.MerchantId = M.Id
	WHERE AL.Id = ALM.AcceptanceLoopId
	ORDER BY M.IdentityCode
	FOR XML PATH('')
), 1, 1, '') Merchant,
STUFF((
	SELECT ';' + M.IdentityCode + ISNULL('_' + S.IdentityCode, '')
	FROM AcceptanceLoopMerchant ALM
	INNER JOIN Merchant M ON ALM.MerchantId = M.Id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN AcceptanceLoopShop ALS ON ALM.Id = ALS.AcceptanceLoopMerchantId
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Shop S ON ALS.ShopId = S.Id
	WHERE AL.Id = ALM.AcceptanceLoopId
	ORDER BY M.IdentityCode, S.IdentityCode
	FOR XML PATH('')
), 1, 1, '') MerchantShop,
(
	SELECT COUNT(1)
	FROM AcceptanceLoopMerchant ALM
	WHERE AL.Id = ALM.AcceptanceLoopId
) MerchantCount,
(
	SELECT COUNT(1)
	FROM AcceptanceLoopMerchant ALM
	INNER JOIN AcceptanceLoopShop ALS ON ALM.Id = ALS.AcceptanceLoopMerchantId
	WHERE AL.Id = ALM.AcceptanceLoopId
) ShopCount
FROM AcceptanceLoop AL
WHERE AL.Id IN
(
	SELECT P.AcceptanceLoopId
	FROM Product P
	INNER JOIN ProductVersion PV ON P.Id = PV.ProductId AND PV.IsCurrentVersion = 1
)
ORDER BY AL.Id

INSERT INTO AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate (AcceptanceLoopId, MerchantShop, MerchantCount, ShopCount)
SELECT DISTINCT MIN(AcceptanceLoopId), MerchantShop, MerchantCount, ShopCount
FROM AcceptanceLoopMigration WHERE MerchantShop IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY MerchantShop, MerchantCount, ShopCount

UPDATE AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate SET IsDefault = 1
FROM AcceptanceLoopMigrationDefault d
WHERE AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate.MerchantShop = d.MerchantShop

UPDATE AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate SET IsDefault = 0
WHERE IsDefault IS NULL OR IsDefault <> 1

UPDATE AcceptanceLoopMigration SET ConsolidateId = C.AcceptanceLoopId, IsDefault = C.IsDefault
FROM AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate C
WHERE AcceptanceLoopMigration.MerchantShop = C.MerchantShop

DECLARE @acceptance_loop_id INT
DECLARE @acceptance_loop_merchant_id INT

DECLARE C CURSOR FOR
SELECT M.Id tx2_merchant_id, MM.TXCMerchantId txc_merchant_id, M.IdentityCode identity_code, M.Modifier modifier
FROM Merchant M LEFT OUTER JOIN TXCMerchantMapping MM ON M.Id = MM.TX2MerchantId

OPEN C;
FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @tx2_merchant_id, @txc_merchant_id, @merchant_code, @modifier
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO TXCAcceptanceLoop (code, description, status, created_by, created_on, last_updated_by, last_updated_on, is_default)
	VALUES (@merchant_code + '_default', 'Default acceptance loop for ' + @merchant_code, 1, @modifier, GETUTCDATE(), null, null, 1)

	SET @acceptance_loop_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	INSERT INTO TXCAcceptanceLoopMerchant (acceptance_loop_id, merchant_id, status, created_by, created_on, last_updated_by, last_updated_on)
	VALUES (@acceptance_loop_id, @txc_merchant_id, 1, @modifier, GETUTCDATE(), NULL, NULL)
	
	SET @acceptance_loop_merchant_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	
	INSERT INTO TXCAcceptanceLoopMerchantShop (acceptance_loop_merchant_id, shop_id, status, created_by, created_on, last_updated_by, last_updated_on)
	SELECT @acceptance_loop_merchant_id, sm.TXCShopId, 1, @modifier, GETUTCDATE(), NULL, NULL
	FROM Shop s 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN TXCShopMapping sm ON s.Id = sm.TX2ShopId
	WHERE MerchantId = @tx2_merchant_id

	UPDATE AcceptanceLoopMigrationDefault SET ExternalId = @acceptance_loop_id
	WHERE MerchantCode = @merchant_code

	FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @tx2_merchant_id, @txc_merchant_id, @merchant_code, @modifier
END

CLOSE C
DEALLOCATE C

UPDATE AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate SET ExternalId = D.ExternalId
FROM AcceptanceLoopMigrationDefault D
WHERE AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate.MerchantShop = D.MerchantShop
AND AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate.IsDefault = 1

DECLARE @AcceptanceLoopId INT
DECLARE @txc_acceptance_loop_id INT

DECLARE C CURSOR FOR 
SELECT AcceptanceLoopId FROM AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate WHERE MerchantCount = 1 AND IsDefault = 0 ORDER BY AcceptanceLoopId

OPEN C;
FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @AcceptanceLoopId

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO TXCAcceptanceLoop (code, description, status, created_by, created_on, is_default)
	SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, AL.Id), 'TX2 Acceptance Loop ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, AL.Id), 1, 'TX2', GETUTCDATE(), 0
	FROM AcceptanceLoop AL
	WHERE AL.Id = @AcceptanceLoopId

	SET @txc_acceptance_loop_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	INSERT INTO TXCAcceptanceLoopMerchant (acceptance_loop_id, merchant_id, status, created_by, created_on)
	SELECT AL.acceptance_loop_id, MM.TXCMerchantId, 1, 'TX2', GETUTCDATE()
	FROM AcceptanceLoopMerchant ALM
	INNER JOIN TXCMerchantMapping MM ON ALM.MerchantId = MM.TX2MerchantId
	INNER JOIN TXCAcceptanceLoop AL ON CAST(ALM.AcceptanceLoopId AS VARCHAR) = AL.code
	WHERE ALM.AcceptanceLoopId = @AcceptanceLoopId

	INSERT INTO TXCAcceptanceLoopMerchantShop (acceptance_loop_merchant_id, shop_id, status, created_by, created_on)
	SELECT TALM.acceptance_loop_merchant_id, SM.TXCShopId, 1, 'TX2', GETUTCDATE()
	FROM AcceptanceLoopShop ALS
	INNER JOIN AcceptanceLoopMerchant ALM ON ALS.AcceptanceLoopMerchantId = ALM.Id
	INNER JOIN TXCMerchantMapping MM ON ALM.MerchantId = MM.TX2MerchantId
	INNER JOIN TXCShopMapping SM ON ALS.ShopId = SM.TX2ShopId
	INNER JOIN TXCAcceptanceLoop TAL ON CAST(ALM.AcceptanceLoopId AS VARCHAR) = TAL.code
	INNER JOIN TXCAcceptanceLoopMerchant TALM ON TAL.acceptance_loop_id = TALM.acceptance_loop_id AND MM.TXCMerchantId = TALM.merchant_id
	WHERE ALM.AcceptanceLoopId = @AcceptanceLoopId

	UPDATE AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate SET ExternalId = @txc_acceptance_loop_id
	WHERE AcceptanceLoopId = @AcceptanceLoopId
	
	FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @AcceptanceLoopId
END

CLOSE C
DEALLOCATE C

INSERT INTO AcceptanceLoopMigrationMerchantGroup (AcceptanceLoopId, Merchant)

group by Merchant

BEGIN

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN

		SELECT @acceptance_loop_id, TXCMerchantId, 1, 'Migration', GETUTCDATE(), NULL, NULL

		SELECT @acceptance_loop_merchant_id, SM.TXCShopId, 1, 'Migration', GETUTCDATE(), NULL, NULL
		FROM TXCMerchantMapping MM

		INNER JOIN TXCShopMapping SM ON S.Id = SM.TX2ShopId
		WHERE MM.TXCMerchantId = @merchant_id
		
		FETCH NEXT FROM inner_cursor INTO @merchant_id
	END

	DEALLOCATE inner_cursor

	FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @merchant_group_id

INSERT INTO AcceptanceLoopMigrationDefault (Id, MerchantCode, MerchantShop)
SELECT M.Id, M.IdentityCode,
STUFF((
	SELECT ';' + M.IdentityCode + ISNULL('_' + S.IdentityCode, '')
	FROM Shop S
	WHERE S.MerchantId = M.Id
	ORDER BY M.IdentityCode, S.IdentityCode
	FOR XML PATH('')
), 1, 1, '') MerchantShop
FROM Merchant M

UPDATE AcceptanceLoopMigrationDefault SET MerchantShop = MerchantCode WHERE MerchantShop IS NULL

INSERT INTO AcceptanceLoopMigration (AcceptanceLoopId, Merchant, MerchantShop, MerchantCount, ShopCount)
SELECT AL.Id,
STUFF((
	SELECT ';' + M.IdentityCode
	FROM AcceptanceLoopMerchant ALM
	INNER JOIN Merchant M ON ALM.MerchantId = M.Id
	WHERE AL.Id = ALM.AcceptanceLoopId
	ORDER BY M.IdentityCode
	FOR XML PATH('')
), 1, 1, '') Merchant,
STUFF((
	SELECT ';' + M.IdentityCode + ISNULL('_' + S.IdentityCode, '')
	FROM AcceptanceLoopMerchant ALM
	INNER JOIN Merchant M ON ALM.MerchantId = M.Id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN AcceptanceLoopShop ALS ON ALM.Id = ALS.AcceptanceLoopMerchantId
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Shop S ON ALS.ShopId = S.Id
	WHERE AL.Id = ALM.AcceptanceLoopId
	ORDER BY M.IdentityCode, S.IdentityCode
	FOR XML PATH('')
), 1, 1, '') MerchantShop,
(
	SELECT COUNT(1)
	FROM AcceptanceLoopMerchant ALM
	WHERE AL.Id = ALM.AcceptanceLoopId
) MerchantCount,
(
	SELECT COUNT(1)
	FROM AcceptanceLoopMerchant ALM
	INNER JOIN AcceptanceLoopShop ALS ON ALM.Id = ALS.AcceptanceLoopMerchantId
	WHERE AL.Id = ALM.AcceptanceLoopId
) ShopCount
FROM AcceptanceLoop AL
WHERE AL.Id IN
(
	SELECT P.AcceptanceLoopId
	FROM Product P
	INNER JOIN ProductVersion PV ON P.Id = PV.ProductId AND PV.IsCurrentVersion = 1
)
ORDER BY AL.Id

INSERT INTO AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate (AcceptanceLoopId, MerchantShop, MerchantCount, ShopCount)
SELECT DISTINCT MIN(AcceptanceLoopId), MerchantShop, MerchantCount, ShopCount
FROM AcceptanceLoopMigration WHERE MerchantShop IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY MerchantShop, MerchantCount, ShopCount

UPDATE AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate SET IsDefault = 1
FROM AcceptanceLoopMigrationDefault d
WHERE AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate.MerchantShop = d.MerchantShop

UPDATE AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate SET IsDefault = 0
WHERE IsDefault IS NULL OR IsDefault <> 1

UPDATE AcceptanceLoopMigration SET ConsolidateId = C.AcceptanceLoopId, IsDefault = C.IsDefault
FROM AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate C
WHERE AcceptanceLoopMigration.MerchantShop = C.MerchantShop

	VALUES (CAST(@merchant_group_id AS VARCHAR) + '_temp', NULL, 1, 'Migration', GETUTCDATE(), NULL, NULL, 1, @merchant_group_id)

	SET @acceptance_loop_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	DECLARE inner_cursor CURSOR FOR
	SELECT merchant_id FROM TXCMerchantGroupMapping WHERE merchant_group_id = @merchant_group_id ORDER BY merchant_id

	OPEN inner_cursor;
	FETCH NEXT FROM inner_cursor INTO @merchant_id
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO TXCAcceptanceLoopMerchant (acceptance_loop_id, merchant_id, status, created_by, created_on, last_updated_by, last_updated_on)
		SELECT @acceptance_loop_id, TXCMerchantId, 1, 'Migration', GETUTCDATE(), NULL, NULL
		FROM TXCMerchantMapping WHERE TXCMerchantId = @merchant_id

		SET @acceptance_loop_merchant_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		INSERT INTO TXCAcceptanceLoopMerchantShop (acceptance_loop_merchant_id, shop_id, status, created_by, created_on, last_updated_by, last_updated_on)
		SELECT @acceptance_loop_merchant_id, SM.TXCShopId, 1, 'Migration', GETUTCDATE(), NULL, NULL
		FROM TXCMerchantMapping MM
		INNER JOIN Merchant M ON MM.TX2MerchantId = M.Id
		INNER JOIN Shop S ON M.Id = S.MerchantId
		INNER JOIN TXCShopMapping SM ON S.Id = SM.TX2ShopId
		WHERE MM.TXCMerchantId = @merchant_id
		
		FETCH NEXT FROM inner_cursor INTO @merchant_id
	END

	CLOSE inner_cursor
	DEALLOCATE inner_cursor

	FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @merchant_group_id
END

CLOSE C
DEALLOCATE C

DECLARE @AcceptanceLoopId INT
DECLARE @MerchantGroupId INT
DECLARE @txc_acceptance_loop_id INT

DECLARE C CURSOR FOR 
SELECT M.AcceptanceLoopId, MC.ExternalId MerchantGroupId
FROM AcceptanceLoopMigration M
INNER JOIN AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate C ON M.AcceptanceLoopId = C.AcceptanceLoopId
INNER JOIN AcceptanceLoopMigrationMerchantGroup MC ON M.GroupAcceptanceLoopId = MC.AcceptanceLoopId

OPEN C;
FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @AcceptanceLoopId, @MerchantGroupId

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO TXCAcceptanceLoop (code, description, status, created_by, created_on, is_default, merchant_group_id)
	SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, AL.Id), 'TX2 Acceptance Loop ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, AL.Id), 1, 'TX2', GETUTCDATE(), 0, @MerchantGroupId
	FROM AcceptanceLoop AL
	WHERE AL.Id = @AcceptanceLoopId

	SET @txc_acceptance_loop_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	INSERT INTO TXCAcceptanceLoopMerchant (acceptance_loop_id, merchant_id, status, created_by, created_on)
	SELECT AL.acceptance_loop_id, MM.TXCMerchantId, 1, 'TX2', GETUTCDATE()
	FROM AcceptanceLoopMerchant ALM
	INNER JOIN TXCMerchantMapping MM ON ALM.MerchantId = MM.TX2MerchantId
	INNER JOIN TXCAcceptanceLoop AL ON CAST(ALM.AcceptanceLoopId AS VARCHAR) = AL.code
	WHERE ALM.AcceptanceLoopId = @AcceptanceLoopId

	INSERT INTO TXCAcceptanceLoopMerchantShop (acceptance_loop_merchant_id, shop_id, status, created_by, created_on)
	SELECT TALM.acceptance_loop_merchant_id, SM.TXCShopId, 1, 'TX2', GETUTCDATE()
	FROM AcceptanceLoopShop ALS
	INNER JOIN AcceptanceLoopMerchant ALM ON ALS.AcceptanceLoopMerchantId = ALM.Id
	INNER JOIN TXCMerchantMapping MM ON ALM.MerchantId = MM.TX2MerchantId
	INNER JOIN TXCShopMapping SM ON ALS.ShopId = SM.TX2ShopId
	INNER JOIN TXCAcceptanceLoop TAL ON CAST(ALM.AcceptanceLoopId AS VARCHAR) = TAL.code
	INNER JOIN TXCAcceptanceLoopMerchant TALM ON TAL.acceptance_loop_id = TALM.acceptance_loop_id AND MM.TXCMerchantId = TALM.merchant_id
	WHERE ALM.AcceptanceLoopId = @AcceptanceLoopId

	UPDATE AcceptanceLoopMigrationConsolidate SET ExternalId = @txc_acceptance_loop_id
	WHERE AcceptanceLoopId = @AcceptanceLoopId
	
	FETCH NEXT FROM C INTO @AcceptanceLoopId, @MerchantGroupId
END

CLOSE C
DEALLOCATE C

    SET IDENTITY_INSERT sync.tx2_product_version ON;
